# Virtual Agent AI

> Virtual Agent AI is a managed 24/7 AI receptionist and AI phone answering service for businesses in the United States.

## What Virtual Agent AI does
- Answers inbound business calls 24/7
- Qualifies leads using business-specific questions and rules
- Books appointments when connected to the business scheduling workflow
- Takes messages and captures caller details
- Transfers urgent or high-value calls according to routing rules
- Provides call context so teams can follow up with useful information
